{{Quote|Reckless bounty hunters have attacked a separatist village not too far from here.|[[Mors Odrion]]|<ref name="The Barani Conspiracy">{{WEGCite|story=The Barani Conspiracy|book=Secrets of the Sisar Run}}</ref>}}
An [[Water/Legends|underwater]] '''village''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] was home to a group of [[Sedrian]] separatists in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Sedri civil war]]. It was attacked and massacred by a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]&ndash;affiliated team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], who were searching for the stolen [[Barani List]] in the nearby underwater [[Cave/Legends|caves]]. When a rival group of Black Sun&ndash;affiliated [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] arrived at the village, they were [[Skirmish in the underwater caves|attacked]] by four Sedrian survivors, who later joined their side in a battle against the mercenaries.
